_meta.description: T4 envelope manifest fragment: adds the FXRates child entry to the existing BookkeepingMultiCurrency menu (BankAccounts + CurrencyBalances were shipped by the T3 sibling fragment) plus the FXRates index + FXRateDetail detail page pair binding to the FxRate register declared in lib/Settings/register.d/add-shillinq-multi-currency-t4.json.

config._note: REFERENCE-DATA record (one FX rate observation: a currency pair on an effective date). The body is the full provenance of the rate — pair, effective date, source, rate and inverse rate, plus any manual-override reason and the ingestion timestamp — because in multi-currency accounting every conversion must be defensible against a specific, dated, sourced rate. A leaf with no children and no comms. The audit trail sidebar is decisive for a manually overridden rate: it records who changed a number that revalues balances.

pages.title: FX Rates (Admin)
pages._note: Operator overlay on top of the declarative FxRate grid: an import-status strip that reads /api/admin/fx-rate-import-status for the last FxRateImportJob run timestamp and the TreasuryRateAdapter dormancy flag. Those two values come from job/adapter state, not from any FxRate object, so `type: index` — whose whole surface is rows of one register/schema — has nowhere to put them. The rate list itself stays declarative on the FxRates page; this page exists only for the cron-health header.
